items.title: Loren Schoenberg interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, January 14, 2019
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] My name is Monk Rowe for the Fillius Jazz Archive. I’m very pleased to have Loren Schoenberg here today.

ctx.x: He was interviewed in New York City on January 14, 2019 by Monk Rowe, Director of the Fillius Jazz Archive.
My name is Monk Rowe for the Fillius Jazz Archive. I’m very pleased to have Loren Schoenberg here today. And I read through your resume, it only took a half an hour.
